subject: Engagement timing & insurance clauses for 2027 pen test renewal
content_summary: Discussion to finalize 2027 annual pen test SOW: attack window constraints, insurance minimums, evidence transfer process, and PO timing. Vendor provided updated SOW and COI; internal legal to review redlines before DocuSign.
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@blackpeaksec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft SOW + timing constraints for annual assessment

Alex —

Thanks for the updated SOW (v3) — received and skimmed. A couple of items we need to lock down before I push this to Legal for redlines: 

- Attack window: we cannot run intrusive tests during our EMEA launch freeze (Aug 15–Aug 30). Can you confirm BlackPeak can accommodate a test window either before Aug 10 or after Sep 5?
- Evidence transfer: we need an encrypted artifact transfer process (SCP or S3 with envelope encryption). Please outline how you plan to deliver logs/evidence and retention period.
- COI: our procurement requires a minimum of $5M cyber liability; do you have current insurance docs we can attach to the PO?
- Rate card: please confirm hourly rates for in-scope web & mobile app testing and a fixed price for the red-team day.

Attaching v3 you sent for reference. If you can update the SOW with the alternate windows and a short paragraph on artifact handling we can move to Legal.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments: BlackPeak_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@blackpeaksec.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@blackpeaksec.com, sales@blackpeaksec.com
Date: 2027-07-03T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + timing constraints for annual assessment

Vanessa —

Thanks for the notes. Quick replies inline: 

- Attack window: we can accommodate either Jul 26–Aug 6 (preferred) or Sep 6–Sep 17. We try to avoid windows where customers have scheduled releases; the Jul slot would avoid your Aug freeze.
- Evidence transfer: we can provide a time-boxed S3 bucket with SSE-KMS and a rotating pre-signed URL for retrieval; we will also provide sha256 checksums for each archive. Retention on our side defaults to 90 days unless you request longer archival.
- Insurance: attaching our current COI showing $5M cyber liability and general liability coverage.
- Rates: included in the rate card attachment — fixed-price red team day is listed as USD 18,000/day; application testing blocks are hourly (lead tester $265/h, tester $165/h).

I've attached: BlackPeak_SOW_v3_with_windows.pdf, certificate-of-insurance.pdf, rate-card-2027.xlsx. If Jul 26 works we can tentatively hold it for you and issue a formal change to the SOW.

If you'd like a 30-minute call to run through the artifact flow and scope carve-outs, I'm available Tue/Thu next week.

—Alex
Alex Rivera | Engagement Lead, BlackPeak Security
alex.rivera@blackpeaksec.com
Attachments: certificate-of-insurance.pdf, rate-card-2027.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@blackpeaksec.com>
Date: 2027-07-07T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + timing constraints for annual assessment

Alex / Vanessa —

Jul 26–Aug 6 looks workable for engineering; we prefer the earlier window. Two small scope asks from the product/security side: 

1) Exclusion list: we need to explicitly exclude load-testing on production payment endpoints and any tests that could trigger customer notifications. Add a short carve-out section for payment flows.
2) Evidence retention: we need one-year retention for raw evidence for audit purposes (we can redact PII prior to handoff if necessary).

Vanessa — can you hold Jul 26 as tentative and I will confirm with Eng by EOD Friday. Karthik — any red flags on the COI or rates?

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Product Security, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@blackpeaksec.com>, contracts@blackpeaksec.com
Date: 2027-07-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Finalize SOW window & next steps for PO / legal review

Team —

Engineering confirmed the Jul 26 start. Alex — please mark Jul 26–Jul 30 on your calendar as held; we'll finalize exact weekdays once Legal completes redlines. 

Laura — can you take the attached SOW (v3 with windows and the COI) and run redlines focused on: indemnity, data handling / evidence retention (they propose 90 days; Marissa requested 1 year), and the insurance addendum. If you could turn that around by Tue (2027-07-19) that keeps us on schedule to get a PO in place by July 22.

Procurement / Finance notes for PO prep: vendor rate card attached; finance prefers a single-line fixed engagement for the red-team week + separate hourly block for remediation support. 

Alex — once Legal gives the green light we'll send a PO number and expect a DocuSign envelope. Please share a DocuSign link when ready (HubSpot will need the contract id).

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: BlackPeak_SOW_v3_with_windows.pdf, certificate-of-insurance.pdf
